header: ANNOUNCEMENTS AS SOURCES OF A DEEP SUMMARY (EDS): their full text (the body, then the text of the PDF) as the engine reads it, and the name a reader sees for each. I keep the numbers they travel under in src/lib/search/sourceKey.ts.

symbols.name: EDS_SOURCE_CHARS
doc: the most characters of one source handed to the writer; I use the circulars' own budget

symbols.name: announcementFullText
symbols.sig: export function announcementFullText(body: string | null | undefined, pdfText: string | null | undefined): string
doc: body, then the PDF's text, clamped: this is what the engine reads of an announcement

symbols.name: announcementLabel
symbols.sig: export function announcementLabel(title: string, date: string | null | undefined): string
doc: I name an announcement to the reader in the briefing like this: Announcement "Title" (17 Nov 2026)

symbols.name: fetchAnnouncementFullText
symbols.sig: export async function fetchAnnouncementFullText(ds: DataSource, ids: number[]): Promise<Map<number, string>>
doc: The full text of these announcements by their real id. A database without the index tables gives the body alone; a failure gives nothing, and the caller keeps the search excerpt.
